book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu agal salau

content: Pol zaug Barnabas dual Aikoniam uzan Uwait nugau Ze duailel maremenin.

Pol zaug Barnabas dual Aikoniam uzan Zuda duailel agal gotulanemen zaueim simai, Antiok ban uzan guzenemen sul, duailel Uwait nugau Ze gusig marena, duailel asiu, Zuda duailel mui, emgasag ipal ebuan duailel mui, go goagal oiagab Yesus en petak emenin.
Bo, Zuda duailel ipal goagal oiagab petak ab tam, goagen emgasag ipal ebuan duailel agal oiagab asai marena, go Kristen duailel en aiag sisilemen.

Bo, Pol zaug Barnabas dual go Aikoniam uzan ziwas huia daimai, Uwait nugau Ze duailel gusig maremenin. Guzenaimai, Uwait nug gonugau ougab naliu mui eiman go isanaraimai, gusig marena, gugeg beu beu memenin. Go guzenina, Uwait nug duailel gonugau ze petak pet tapaimareun.
Uzanan duailel go unum atalaimai, Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu ipal sesamaremenin, duailel ipal go Zuda duailel agal igul sesamoremenin.

Guzenaimai, Zuda duailel ipal mui, emgasag ipal ebuan duailel mui, goagal dudu banban ereg gotulaimai, goagen Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu eg maraimai, aiwag sil ugarebi, noumamam aimai dabilemenin.
Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu go ze go doimai, Likonia agaig agal ban uzan aliag wanimag Listra mui Derbe mui ipal em uzan go waugab uminai wanemenin.
Go ebu go Yesus nugau Ze Naliupet duailel maremenin.
Listra uzanan du tub arab ubuneun kasai memenin.
Listra uzanan du tub go gonugau arab ubuneun mui dareun. Go anag nug arab ubuneun mui soligweun, gonun, go aidabun iborain tam.

Go hoboi daimai, Pol nug Uwait nugau Ze mareun doi dareun. Pol gue du gonugau ougab petak eun abe maimai, go naliu usalabun iboin, gusig uligaimai, duailel ameagab ebu aureun, “Na asaib, em e tapen.” Pigai, du go gonugau arab ubuneun silikaimai, em tapeun.
Duailel gugeg go Pol nug meun uligaimai, goagal ze eiman gusig ulaimai, enemen, “Igual em Uwait go du sul alaloimai, ig ebiligeb alemen.”
Guzenaimai, goagen Barnabas wanib go Sus emenin. Pol go ze maraneun du, gonun, gonugau wanib Hermes emenin.

Go em Uwait Sus nugau ula dacaneun du, gonugau zobu zau uzan go uzaneim dareu, go ze go doimai, bulumakau zawai ipal mui, a sisil iweiu naliu mui oimai, uzan gilan waugab zoun. Gonugau duailel mui Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu go agal wanimag ebu agaimai, ulagwag marabun zomenin.

Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu Barnabas zaug Pol dual, go igul go mabun dabilei daimai, goagal oiagab eg waimai, goagal tibur galau bigagaimai, pigai duailel go ula beteimai, awaremen, “Igual zaiger, ag igul go einen mabun dabilemen? Ig du ag sul, ig em Uwait tam. Ig e ebu Uwait nugau Ze naliu awarabun alemun. Ag polu wes go semoroiban, Uwait go awau dacaneu, go nug emes mui, em mui, ibut ze mui, ece unum patai meun, goen tutak agal oiagab petak an.
Getal gonug duailel ein igul guzenabun tapelab tam.
Bo, Uwait go wagemab tam, gonug ig igul naliu abai miganeu. Gonug ze palautina, nuna, agal ougem ee ug naliu walu zuna, ee zaimai, ag siksikanemen.”

Yesus nugau ze oi aidanemen dudu aliag agen duailel go egun biz ebu agaimai, ig ulapigwag i migen aimai awaremenin. Bo, duailel go igul guzenina, agen go kuatai ze awarabun salau gusig pet mina, go igul go utemenin.

Guze guzenina, Zuda dudu ipal Antiok ban uzan Pisidia agaig ebuan mui, Aikoniam uzanan alaimai, duailel goagen goagal oiagab tutak mabun ze maraimai, goagal dabeleu koli kekulai maraimai, guzenai awaremenin, “Ag dudu go aiwag sil wagaran.” Guzenai awarina, goagen Pol aiwag sil wemenin. Guzenaimai, goagen go noumeu dabeleimai, go uzaneim patai keuai noimai hamacemen.
Bo, duailel goagal oiagab petak emen go Pol waugab zoimai, talioroi katai darena, Pol gue asaimai, uzan go koli sieun. Nineimai, umaseu, Barnabas zaug Pol dual go Derbe uzan wanemenin.
Pol zaug Barnabas dual koli Antiok ban uzan Siria agaig ebu betemenin.

Pol zaug Barnabas dual go Derbe uzan daimai, Uwait nugau Ze Naliupet marena, duailel asiu goagal oiagab ailaimai, Yesus sesamoremenin. Guzenaimai, Pol zaug Barnabas dual go koli Listra uzan beteimai, go eiman koli Aikoniam uzan beteimai, go eiman Antiok ban uzan Pisidia agaig betemenin.

Guzenaimai, go duailel goagal oiagab gusig maraimai, goagal oiagab petak emen i utabun aimai dabeleu gusig maremenin. Goagen awaremen, “Ig unum Uwait nugau gumigabun uzan siabun uhu asiu oimai simam.”

Go uzan tutak tutak ebu beteimai, duailel oiagab petak emen abai ereg gotulaimai, duailel goagen gumarabun dudu tapai maremenin. Go ziwas ipal ebu, ee ur maimai, Uwait auraimai, go Uwait nugau ebeg ebu maremenin.
Pisidia agaig go unum aidaimai, go koli Pampilia agaig ebu alemenin.
Uwait nugau Ze Perga uzanan duailel maraimai, Atalia uzan nomen.

Go uzanan tebil wag koli Antiok uzan betemenin. Uzan tub getal duailel goagen Uwait nugau ougab naliu mui eiman go isanarabun aurina, Yesus nugau ze duailel marabun palautaremen, salau go ag ulis unum poemenin.
Go Antiok ban uzan alaimai, duailel goagen oiagab petak emen go igul unum guzenemenin mui erunai Uwait nug emgasag ipal ebuan duailel oiagab petak abun abu abai mareun en awaremenin.
Go ziwas huia, duailel goagal oiagab petak emen go abai daremenin.
